note: Flat faces of the Houmuwu ding (KIT.md § Flat faces). Points are [photo px in the ORIGINAL (Commons full size), vessel mm x, y, z]; the committed 1800-px copies are used (scaled) until `tools/faces.mjs --rectify --fetch` can download the originals (Commons answered 429 when these were made), so today every flattened face is an upsampled ≈ 0.9–1.7 px/mm source. Landmarks are IN-PLANE: the four corners of the recessed plain field (inner frame corners: u = ±(half-wall − 120 mm column), y 857 / 591 per the dossier), the mid-wall flange axis at the wall top (y 985) and wall bottom (y 465). The corner flanges stand ≈ 28 mm out of the wall plane and were not used. ppmm 2 = what the originals support (≈ 2.4 px/mm); the leiwen (1.9 mm pitch) is NOT resolved in any of these faces.

face-short.label: short (handle) face (+X), whole wall
face-short.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 5.55 mm, max 6.39 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-short.trust: good: near head-on at ≈ 1.7 px/mm (committed copy); the best-resolved Houmuwu face. BUT the right side column comes out ≈ 35 mm wider than the left (157 vs 122 mm): either a plain strip runs along the field's right edge in this photograph or the right field corners are misplaced; treat horizontal positions in the right third as ± 15–35 mm until a second photograph or the full-size original settles it.

face-rubbing-long.label: ink rubbing of a long face, registered to the long wall
face-rubbing-long.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 5.43 mm, max 7.9 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-rubbing-long.trust: the rubbing is a developed (true-size) image of the wall, but paper stretch and the mounting make it ±1–2 %; registered on the field corners and the mid-flange ends. Black = raised, white = recessed; the field reads as mottled grey.
